items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: He'd do all his dirty work and he'd have a guy, like, in Washington called "Weak Knees," a bad guy, and he'd have him protecting him all the time when he was in Washington.

ctx.x: Yeah, he kept her. What else he's going to do?
And Duke was a coward. He'd do all his dirty work and he'd have a guy, like, in Washington called "Weak Knees," a bad guy, and he'd have him protecting him all the time when he was in Washington.
He had a bodyguard named "Weak Knees"?
